message: We have exhausted every conventional avenue while Beta has entrenched its advantage. We will not allow the summit to freeze an outcome that leaves us permanently deprived of oranium. Unless Beta accepts an immediate, verifiable transfer that restores balance, we will take decisive action to secure our survival.
